s: New Dataflow Gen2 → paste the Beginner M (Advanced editor) → set the source to the CSV (OneLake file or web).
Data destination → Lakehouse (or Warehouse) → new table orders_clean → choose column types explicitly.
Schedule the dataflow; point two semantic models (or a Direct Lake model and an Import model) at orders_clean.
Change a rule in the dataflow; both models pick it up after the next run.
fab-pipelines-0.check: orders_clean has 27 rows and 8 columns; one fix, two consumers.

s: Bronze: mirrored database (NorthwindDW) plus raw files; immutable; owner data engineering.
Silver: deduplicated order lines (ROW_NUMBER), typed, test customer flagged, EUR converted with the monthly rate; tests: key uniqueness, FK, ranges.
Gold: Warehouse star schema materialised (no views for the model); owner BI team; read by Direct Lake on OneLake.
Promotion silver → gold only if tests pass.
fab-pipelines-1.check: Three owned layers, tests between them, materialised gold for the model.

s: Pipeline activities: Dataflow (or a wait on mirroring freshness) → Stored procedure (DQ checks raise errors) → Stored procedure (gold load) → Semantic model refresh → Web/notebook activity running test queries → Teams/Outlook notification.
On failure: downstream activities don't run; failure path notifies the team; the model keeps the last good data.
